annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires the server to send an appropriate 3xx response when it cannot apply the PUT to the target resource and instead wishes to apply it to a different resource (e.g., a moved URI). The user agent may decide whether to follow the redirection. No two materially different interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
